title: Mr3D-VL: A generalist vision language foundation model for Multiparametric 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2608.12689v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-parametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) is a cornerstone for brain tumor diagnosis and treatment, yet current AI models face critical limitations: their lack of natural language interaction and interpretability impedes spatial information integration and cross-modal reasoning required clinically. Key challenges arise from significant physical meaning differences across modalities, spatial misalignment due to scan intervals, and the need for complex multi-feature interpretation in tasks like glioma grading. While visual-language models (VLMs) show promise in cross-modal understanding, existing methods focus mainly on 2D image modeling, neglecting direct perception of 3D volumetric space. Although 3D VLMs have been proposed for report generation and feature alignment in 3D CT imaging, mpMRI applications demand collaborative inference across multiple imaging modalities-a requirement unmet by current solutions. translated_title: Mr3D-VL：一种面向多参数三维磁共振成像的通用视觉语言基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12689v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：多参数磁共振成像（mpMRI）是脑肿瘤诊断和治疗的基石，然而当前的人工智能模型面临关键限制：缺乏自然语言交互和可解释性，阻碍了临床所需的时空信息整合和跨模态推理。主要挑战来自不同模态间物理意义的显著差异、扫描间隔导致的空间错位，以及神经胶质瘤分级等任务中复杂多特征解释的需求。虽然视觉语言模型（VLMs）在跨模态理解方面显示出潜力，但现有方法主要侧重于2D图像建模，忽略了对3D体积空间的直接感知。尽管已有针对3D CT成像中报告生成和特征对齐的3D VLM提出，但mpMRI应用需要跨多种成像模态的协作推理——这一需求当前解决方案尚未满足。为解决此问题，
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Mr3D-VL的通用视觉语言基础模型，旨在解决多参数三维MRI中跨模态协作推理和自然语言交互的不足，通过直接感知3D体积空间来提升脑肿瘤诊断的可解释性和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Mr3D-VL, a generalist vision-language foundation model addressing cross-modal collaborative inference and natural language interaction limitations in multiparametric 3D MRI, enhancing interpretability and accuracy in brain tumor diagnosis through direct 3D volumetric perception.
